abstract_findings.finding: Systems analyses of meningococcal polysaccharide and conjugate vaccines identified distinct transcriptional signatures of antibody responses for different vaccine classes.
The distinct signatures provided insights into primary viral responses.
The distinct signatures provided insights into protein recall responses.
The distinct signatures provided insights into anti-polysaccharide responses.
Large-scale network integration of public human blood transcriptomes and systems-scale databases was used to deduce a set of blood transcription modules.
The results illuminate early transcriptional programs orchestrating vaccine immunity in humans.
The study demonstrates the power of integrative network modeling.
